nodes.body:
**[high] deleteDocument still signs without documentId**

deleteDocument builds its action through the legacy helper, which never passes documentId to signAction, so a delete signature still verifies on any document.

Also at: `packages/reactor/src/client/reactor-client.ts:1111`

<!-- ghx:v1 {"alsoAt":[{"line":1111,"path":"packages/reactor/src/client/reactor-client.ts"}],"body":"deleteDocument builds its action through the legacy helper, which never passes documentId to signAction, so a delete signature still verifies on any document.","commit":"4b1e7d20c9a35f8e61d24b07c3a9e5f1d8b62c47","gen":"ghx/0.1.0","id":"f_h4x8pz","line":1071,"path":"packages/reactor/src/client/reactor-client.ts","review":"r_7tq2wd","severity":"high","side":"RIGHT","t":"finding","title":"deleteDocument still signs without documentId"} -->

**[low] Rejection error does not name the documentId**

The thrown error says "signature not bound" without the expected and actual documentId, which makes client logs hard to trace.
